title: Russia and Ukraine agree to a large exchange of prisoners of war, officials say
summary: Russia and Ukraine have agreed to a large exchange of prisoners of war. U.S.-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi led to this decision, marking the biggest humanitarian release since the war began in 2022.

title: House effectively ends Hegseth impeachment. And, 3 men accused of plotting U.K. attacks
summary: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth has been spared from the House's impeachment effort, at least for now. And, federal prosecutors arrested three men accused of being Iran-backed operatives.

title: Iran-backed trio accused of plotting attacks on U.K. base hosting U.S. jets
summary: Iran-backed operatives have been charged over nearly 20 attacks, including a plot on a U.K. base housing U.S. troops. Separately, a U.S. soldier is held in the U.K. on Russia spying claims.
